title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Tracking Area Update procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating UE's tracking area information in the network.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by network to accept tracking area update request.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject tracking area update request.

entities.name: DETACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate detach procedure.

entities.name: EPS update type
entities.description: Information element indicating type of EPS update being requested.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element containing cause values for EMM procedures.

entities.name: T3450
entities.description: Timer used for TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message retransmission.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EMM state where UE is registered but has no active NAS signalling connection.

entities.name: Lower layer failure
entities.description: Condition indicating failure in lower layer communication before message delivery.

entities.name: Protocol error
entities.description: Condition indicating protocol error in received message.

entities.name: GUTI validity handling
entities.description: Network behavior to consider both old and new GUTI as valid until old GUTI can be invalidated.

entities.name: Paging with IMSI
entities.description: Network behavior to page UE using IMSI when paging with S-TMSI fails.

relations.description: Tracking area update procedure starts with TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.
Tracking area update procedure includes sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
Tracking area update procedure completes with TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message.
Lower layer failure before TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE establishes GUTI validity handling.
Lower layer failure causes network to enter EMM-IDLE mode.
Sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message starts timer T3450.
On timer T3450 expiry, network resets and restarts timer and retransmits TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT.
Protocol error in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST establishes sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT message contains EMM cause information element.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message contains EPS update type information element.
DETACH REQUEST message received during tracking area update procedure triggers specific handling.
Paging with IMSI requires UE to be in EMM-IDLE mode for re-attach procedure.
